sloka: प्राप्य पूजां दशग्रीवो मधुवेश्मानि वीर्यवान् ।तत्र चैकां निशामुष्य गमनायोपचक्रमे ।। ७.२५.५१ ॥
transliteration: prāpya pūjāṁ daśagrīvo madhuveśmāni vīryavān ।tatra caikāṁ niśāmuṣya gamanāyopacakrame ।। 7.25.51 ॥

translations.english: The powerful Ravana, having received worship in Madhu's abode and stayed there for one night, then prepared for his departure.
